# sample-project

## Preclear configuration

```yaml
preclear:
  version: 1
  backend: checkpoint-v1
  executable: /path/to/checkpoint
  project: /path/to/sample-project
  task: widget-export
  ledger: /path/to/sample-project/thoughts/ledgers/CONTINUITY_CLAUDE-widget-export.md
  fallback_directory: /path/to/sample-project/.preclear
```
